title: Join {gym} on SimpleFit.

abilities.title: As a member you can
abilities.classes: See this gym's classes and book a place
abilities.bookings: Keep your bookings in one place
abilities.private: The gym sees your bookings and attendance. Your training log stays private unless you share it.

acceptHint: You join the gym only when you accept. This creates a gym membership and nothing else: no Fighter or Coach profile, and no staff role.

decline.confirm: Decline the invitation to {gym}? You won't join the gym, and it would need to invite you again.

linkDoneHint: This email is now on your account. Next, review the invitation.

actions.site: Go to the SimpleFit home page

signedOut.body: To answer, sign in or create an account. You'll confirm the invited email with a code; opening this link doesn't sign you in.

missing.title: Open the invitation from your email
missing.body: We couldn't find an invitation in this link, or this tab's session ended. Open the link in your invitation email again.

mismatch.title: This invitation is for another email.
mismatch.body: Verify the invited email on this account, or sign in with the account that uses it.

registration.title: Finish your account first.
registration.body: You can accept once your account is set up. We'll bring you back here.

unavailable.title: This invitation isn't available
unavailable.body: It may have expired or been withdrawn, or it may be for someone else. Ask the gym to invite you again.
unavailable.signedOut: It may have expired or been withdrawn. If it was sent to you, sign in to see what happened, or ask the gym to invite you again.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: The invitation to {gym} is no longer valid. Ask the gym to send a new one.

cancelled.title: This invitation was withdrawn
cancelled.body: {gym} withdrew this invitation. Ask the gym if you think that's a mistake.

declined.title: You declined this invitation
declined.body: You declined the invitation to {gym}, and you didn't join. The gym can invite you again.
declined.justNow: You didn't join {gym}. The gym can invite you again if you change your mind.

accessEnded.title: This membership has ended
accessEnded.body: You accepted this invitation, but your membership of {gym} has since ended. To come back, ask the gym for a new invitation or its join code.

alreadyMember.title: You're already a member of {gym}
alreadyMember.body: Your account is already a member of this gym, so nothing changed.

limited.title: Too many attempts.
limited.body: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

failed.title: We couldn't confirm that.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing is shown as done until the server confirms it.
